data_gaps: Google Maps, Yellow Pages, BBB, Superpages, Angi, BuildZoom, Bradford White and 2FindLocal pages returned HTTP 403 or were unreachable, so map- and Yellow-Pages-sourced entries could only be checked through search-result text, not by opening the cited page.

Five of the seven suspicious HVAC/roofing entries rest on Google Maps pins I could not open; 'not found' for them means no corroboration in any accessible source plus an address occupied by a different business, not proof of non-existence.

loc8nearme and njbusinessdirectory are secondary compilations and contain stale rows (e.g. Vintage Vinyl Records closed in 2021, Woodbridge Builders was last advertised in the late 1980s); both were excluded from the missing list once found defunct.

Landscaping/exterminating searches for Keasbey and Hopelawn returned only service-area providers with no zone address (D & S Landscaping, Landscaping Perez, Vonch's, Barboza, One Way Termite, E & G Exterminators), so they could not be counted as either listed or missing.

The coverage ratio (45/66, about 68%) is borderline: dropping the five weakest missing candidates would push it just above 70%. The FAIL verdict rests mainly on entries that are contradicted or uncorroborated, not on coverage alone.
